answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16057 Country: India Title: " In fasting condition is kissing to wife is allowed by puting toung in her mouth if it is yes is it allowed in both following cases? 1.How many time we should spit after wadu to make sure water does not go in to mouth? 2.Wife is not fasting 3.Wife also fasting " Question: " In fasting condition is kissing to wife is allowed by puting toung in her mouth if it is yes is it allowed in both following cases? 1.How many time we should spit after wadu to make sure water does not go in to mouth? 2.Wife is not fasting 3.Wife also fasting " Answer ID: 16057 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1524/1524/M=1430) It is makrooh to lick the lips or tongue of wife in mouth whether one fears ejaculation or intercourse or not. Rather, if one swallows the saliva of wife, it will cause qadha as well as kaffarah ; therefore one should avoid kissing lips and mouth while fasting. (2) If there is some wetness after wudhu or rinsing mouth, it is sufficient to spit for satisfaction, otherwise it will not nullify the fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
